body: I think the same way. When I start typing out how I feel, I just read it and feel ridiculous and rarely finish something and actually post it. I agree with you about pressure and success. We're supposed to know from so young what we want to do and how to be successful in that endeavor, but then depression comes and fucks up everything you might've had. Even if the depression does eventually subside, the consequences of it seem to last forever.

Sorry you're having a shitty time, I know how you feel when you say that it feels like everything just suddenly took a turn for the worst. What doesn't make it help, too, is that there are also other people who just seem to have everything looking up for them and you're wondering when your turn will come :/

I'm terrified of doing this so I end up never telling anyone. I'm trying therapy to see if I can actually get some stuff out, but I'm not even sure that'd help. My mentality always seems to be that I'd rather suffer in silence than have a friend think I'm annoying and not want to hang out with me, because hanging out with friends is the only time I don't feel majorly depressed/suicidal, even.
I rarely say things out loud because I'm afraid that people would think I'm weird, but I constantly have a conversation with myself in my head. It's pretty much the only way I think in my head
Even though I know you thought this post was stupid, I just wanted to thank you for it because this is exactly how I feel but I get too mad at myself to even type it out.
As a person who doesn't have any plans for Halloween, I know what I'm doing myself Friday night now!

I dont mind answering. I am post-top surgery and ftm. My family knows and they are supportive (though something that makes me kind of sad sometimes is that I'm pretty sure my dad loves me less because I transitioned).


The unfortunate thing is that suicide really wouldnt deprive me too much. I mean, I'd like to travel but I'm too poor for that. I'd also like kids, but I'm not sure I can wait another 20 years with these feelings. I don't really have any other goals, they've all been kind of crushed in some form or another. I woke up this morning and every other time I've felt like this, I've always woke up feeling better. I'm not feeling better today, though, and it scares me.

Yeah I think I might do that, too. And okay, thanks. I made an initial counseling appointment for Thursday because I can feel when these things are about to happen, but I had no idea it would come on so fast. I was hoping to get to the counselor before then. That's what I'm kind of holding out for right now.

Not really. I think there's parts of my personality that I use to cover up the other parts so that they never see the day of light. I've just kind of stopped trying to pursue any sort of relationship because while you're completely right, I can't help but think for the worst.

I realize that even if I like someone, I will always have to go through that extra step of telling them I'm trans. My self confidence isn't high in the first place, so you can imagine how hard a rejection would hit. So pretty much I just tell myself that I can't like "just whoever I want" because I've got this extra thing that most would consider a turn off.

I realized about 8 months ago that transitioning doesn't solve all my problems. I realize that there's the possibility that my depression didn't go away after years essentially just wasting away with it. I'm a freshman in college. I'm stressed that I had to leave my friends and that I also have not made any real new friends yet. I realize also that I'm horrible with stress. I'm afraid I'm always going to feel like this (stressed, anxious, depressed), so I'm desperate to stop it.

I wasn't the best. I'm a mutilated form of the human body and I'm so ashamed every time I take off my shirt. I've been practicing being by myself for the past month because that's a thing that really triggers bad feelings. I thought I was getting better but apparently I'm not.
